issue_request: FHIR-14825 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue for STU3 asking to clarify FamilyMemberHistory.date. The approved short description was 'When history was recorded or last updated' and the approved long description was 'The date (and possibly time) when the family member history was recorded or last updated'.
initial_application: The change was historically applied in git-svn commit b88fc91916dd76f6587b8f326b9ea447d69381cd, whose subject includes GF#14825 and whose patch changed the old FamilyMemberHistory spreadsheet from captured/updated and taken wording to the approved descriptions. Later source refactors, including 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 and c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6, carried that wording into the current XML StructureDefinition and search parameter source.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has the approved FamilyMemberHistory.date short and definition, and the associated date search parameter description is consistent. Patient Care minutes from 2018-03-08 cite FamilyMemberHistory.date as defined by the same recorded-or-last-updated meaning during a workflow mapping discussion. Quoted Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch now has an empty no-change audit commit documenting that the current build-scope source already satisfies FHIR-14825.
